title: Map Studio — Desktop Split-View Map Editor
description: Standalone Godot scene (not plugin). Left: map selector list. Top: 2D top-down grid editor (paint structure, stamp utilities, place artifacts). Bottom: 3D live preview of the map. Right: inspector panel with artifact config, preview, and screenshot capture. Based on MapCatalogDesktop3D pattern.
earned_from: User tried: web map-builder, voxel editor, raw JSON, @tool plugin. Split-view desktop scene with 2D+3D is the right format.
summary: Standalone scene: map list (left) | 2D grid editor (top) + 3D preview (bottom) | artifact inspector + screenshot (right). Like MapCatalogDesktop3D but for editing.

nodes.label: HSplit: left panel | center split | right panel
nodes.detail: Left: map list (ScrollContainer + buttons per map). Center: VSplit with 2D grid (top) and 3D SubViewport (bottom). Right: inspector panel.

nodes.label: Left panel: map selector
nodes.detail: Scan commons/maps/ for map_data.json. Button per map, grouped by sequence. Click to load.

nodes.label: Top center: 2D grid editor
nodes.detail: Reuse grid rendering from map_grid_editor_dock.gd. Paint structure heights, stamp utilities, place artifacts. Layer toggle tabs.

nodes.label: Bottom center: 3D live preview
nodes.detail: SubViewport with GridSystem loading the map. Updates when 2D grid changes. Orbit camera.

nodes.label: Right panel: artifact inspector
nodes.detail: Selected cell info. If interactable: artifact name, rotation, y_offset. Preview of artifact scene. Screenshot button.

nodes.label: Screenshot capture from inspector
nodes.detail: Expand artifact preview to full size. Capture with PerfectShotFramer. Save to scene-catalog. Uses existing capture pipeline.

nodes.label: Live pathfinder overlay on 2D grid
nodes.detail: Reachability colors: green=reachable from spawn, red=unreachable, blue=teleporter path. Updates on paint.

nodes.label: Save to map_data.json
nodes.detail: Ctrl+S writes layers back to JSON. Preserves map_info, settings, lighting.
